plytix.before: Seedboy Organic Non-GMO Herb Seeds for Planting (Herb Garden Starter Kit)
plytix.after: Seedboy Indoor Herb Garden Starter Kit with 10 USDA Organic Seeds and Pots

plytix.before: Complete Herb Garden Starter Kit - Grow fresh herbs right in your kitchen with this complete indoor gardening set! Includes 10 melamine planter pots with trays, 7 coco coir soil discs, 10 plant markers, 5 organic plant food packets, and 10 premium herb seed varieties carefully selected for flavor and easy growth. Each kit comes with Seedboy's Detailed Grow Guide to ensure success every step of the way. Perfect for fresh, homegrown herbs all year round!
plytix.after: Complete indoor herb garden kit: Everything you need to grow 10 kitchen herbs, packed in one gift box; includes 10 white melamine planters with saucer trays in five sizes matched to each herb, 7 coco coir soil discs that expand to fill all 10 planters, 5 organic plant food packets, 10 bamboo plant markers, 10 organic herb seed packets and an illustrated Grow Guide

plytix.before: Non-GMO & Organic Certified Seeds - Enjoy peace of mind with USDA Certified Organic (by OTCO) and Non-GMO herb seeds. Our Genovese Basil, Peppermint, Rosemary, Italian Flat Leaf Parsley, Slow Bolt Cilantro, Italian Oregano, Thyme, Common Chives, Bouquet Dill, and Broad Leaf Sage seeds are all proudly grown in the USA, bringing healthy, natural goodness straight to your garden.
plytix.after: 10 USDA Organic, non-GMO herb seeds: Genovese basil, peppermint, rosemary, Italian flat-leaf parsley, slow-bolt cilantro, Italian oregano, thyme, common chives, bouquet dill and broad-leaf sage; certified organic by OTCO and grown in the USA; generous seed counts in every packet, including basil (250), cilantro (350), oregano (900), dill (850), thyme (250) and rosemary (60)

plytix.before: Two Simple Rules for Thriving Herbs - Place your herbs in your sunniest window (6+ hours of direct sunlight) or use a grow light, since too little light makes herbs weak and leggy. Your kit includes 5 organic plant food packets to mix into the coir before planting. This slow-release feed works with every watering, so no extra fertilizer is needed for the first several weeks. After that, use any organic herb fertilizer to keep them full and flavorful.
plytix.after: Easy for beginners, two simple rules: Give your herbs light, with six or more hours of direct sun in your sunniest window or 12 to 14 hours under an LED grow light, since too little light makes herbs weak and leggy; feed them by mixing the included organic plant food into the coir before planting; the slow-release feed works with every watering, so no extra fertilizer is needed for the first several weeks

plytix.before: Our Germination Promise - Worried about your seeds not sprouting? If your seeds don't germinate, simply reach out and we'll send a replacement. Your gardening success is our priority.
plytix.after: A page for every herb: The Grow Guide gives each herb its own page with days to sprout, days to harvest, seeds per pot, planting depth, light and water needs, plus soaking tips for slow starters like rosemary and parsley and a troubleshooting section; if nothing sprouts after three weeks of following the guide, contact us through Amazon and we will send replacement seeds

plytix.before: A Gift That Keeps on Growing - More than just a present, this herb garden kit offers an experience of growth, learning, and culinary creativity. A thoughtful gift for gardeners, moms, friends, and plant lovers! Whether for a birthday, housewarming, Mother's Day, or Christmas, this kit brings joy long after it's unwrapped. Generous seed counts included: Basil (250), Peppermint (250), Rosemary (60), Parsley (125), Cilantro (350), Oregano (900), Thyme (250), Chives (125), Dill (850), and Sage (50).
plytix.after: A gift that keeps growing: More than a present, this herb garden kit is an experience of growing, learning and cooking with fresh herbs; a thoughtful gardening gift for women, moms, friends, home cooks and plant lovers, made for Christmas, birthdays, housewarmings and Mother's Day, and still bringing fresh basil, mint and rosemary to the kitchen long after it is unwrapped
